text:
Sam: Quick sync on SilverLake POC timeline — can we lock deliverables and CR owners? I'm proposing integration cut 2026-08-15, UAT 2026-08-22, final go/no-go 2026-08-29. Is that still doable?
Priya: Dates look OK from sales side, but legal asked for SSO & data retention confirmation by Aug 12.
Ellis: Heads up: our webhook schema change in CR#342 might affect the partner connector. If CR lands late, integration cut slips. @Marcos can you take CR review?
Marcos: I can pick up CR#342 tomorrow AM, should be a 2-3hr review unless tests fail. Will comment by EOD.
Ava: Infra note — we need a staging GPU reservation for the trial end-to-end tests. Please create an infra ticket with expected qps and model size.
Sam: Good call, @Ava. I'll raise the ticket now and assign to infra-oncall.
Sam: Also we need explicit success criteria for the trial. From our last convo: 1) <200ms median gen latency for standard prompts, 2) embeddings similarity >= 0.92 on sample set, 3) end-to-end flow working with SSO and webhooks. Anything to add?
Priya: Add biz metric: ingestion-to-first-response < 4s for document upload flows. Customer will flag that.
Ellis: For the webhook change: sample payload below — pls confirm contract or we'll add adapter layer on our side.

``` 
POST /v1/silverlake/events
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "event": "doc_ready",
  "doc_id": "abcd-1234",
  "meta": {"lang":"en", "pages": 12},
  "sign": "hmac:..."
}
```
Marcos: Contract looks fine, but we'll require HMAC header name X-SL-SIGN and timestamp. I'll add that to the CR comments.
Priya: Does the customer need sample app + README, or is a hosted postman collection enough?
Sam: They asked for both: hosted sample app + README, plus Postman collection for easy testing. Owner: @Ellis for sample app, @Priya for Postman + acceptance test checklist.
Ellis: I'll start the sample app skeleton today — should have a basic connector + README by Aug 10.
Ava: Infra ticket created: INF-9876, reserved 2x A100 for 2026-08-13..2026-08-30. Please add expected peak RPS to INF-9876.
Priya: Legal wants data retention window documented — I'll paste the retention section into the trial docs by Aug 12.
Sam: Next actions: Marcos review CR#342 by EOD tomorrow; Ellis deliver sample app skeleton by Aug 10; Priya publish retention & Postman by Aug 12; Ava INF-9876 has reservation, team to add RPS. If any blockers ping in this thread.
Ellis: quick ping for code review once sample app PR is up — will tag @Marcos and @Ava for infra tests.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging/silverlake-demo -> 2026-08-11 09:00 UTC (auto).
Marcos: Reviewed CR#342 — small nit on test coverage, added comment. Once fixed I can merge and cut a release for integration testing.
Sam: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll post a one-slide timeline to the customer workspace after CR merges. :thumbsup:
